d: The theatre is a felsichte area, here and there covered with trees; on beyden sides are walkable mountains, along with a round temple. Tamino comes down in a magnificent japonic hunting dress to the right of a rock, with an arch, but without an arrow; a snake pursues it.
The mountains separate themselves from each other, and the theatre transforms into a magnificent chamber. The queens sit on a throne decorated with transparent stars.

The theatre is a palm forest; all trees are silver-like, the leaves of gold. 18 seats of leaves; on each seat there is a pyramid, and a large black horn with gold. In the middle is the largest pyramid, even the largest trees. Sarastro along with other priests come in cowardly steps, each with a palm branch in his hand. A march with blowing instruments accompanies the train.
Spokesman and the other priest with torches.
Tamino, Papageno, speaker, two priests with torches.
